task_pattern: Protected profile route auth redirect bug
description: Fix protected profile requests that return 401 even when a valid user header is present by updating the legacy auth middleware and profile route.
solution_steps: Inspect the protected profile route and confirm it calls the auth middleware before returning profile data.
Update middleware/auth.js so a valid x-user-id request header sets req.user = { id }.
Return 401 only when req.user is missing.
Have routes/profile.js read req.user.id when building the response.
Run the profile route tests for both authenticated and unauthenticated requests.
pitfalls: Do not fix only routes/profile.js; the 401 usually comes from middleware/auth.js not populating req.user.
The old implementation is header-based and expects x-user-id.
